office: monpasseport.ci (SNEDAI CI): pre-enrolment online, then enrolment at a centre

routes.label: 72 hours after the police validate the documents

note: The time is monpasseport.ci's own (72 hours after the police validate the documents). The fee is paid online or at a partner bank, but neither the platform's pages read nor SNEDAI's state the amount; the only figure found, 40,000 FCFA at home, is from a report of about 2010 and is not taken, so the fee is left unpaid. Validity is a lead.

sources.title: Monpasseport (SNEDAI CI), FAQ
sources.said: Quel est le delai pour obtenir un passeport biométrique ? Le délai d'obtention du passeport en Côte d'Ivoire est de 72 heures après la validation des documents par la police
